entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • InputCheckbox inside QuickGrid has 2 observed bugs: Stuck in Checked Position, and databinding not working as expected #67308
  • [Blazor] Analyzer to warn about JSInterop calls not wrapped in a try catch block #67306
  • HealthCheckPublisherHostedService.StopAsync uses Timer.Dispose() instead of the overload that waits for a running callback #67304
  • Update `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.UI` to support the same passkey UI that got added to the Blazor Web App template #67302
  • Update `MapIdentityApi()` to add endpoints for passkeys #67301
  • Make it easy to configure [well-known passkey endpoints](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-passkey-endpoints/passkey-endpoints.html) so that authenticators can automatically upgrade passwords to passkeys without requiring the customer to visit the site #67300
  • Use the [signals API](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/identity/webauthn-signal-api) to, e.g., inform the authenticator when a passkey was revoked so it doesn't get presented to the user as an option when signing in #67299
  • Support [conditional create](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/identity/webauthn-conditional-create) to allow the user to seamlessly upgrade a password to a passkey after signing in #67298
  • Support passwordless account creation #67297

Closed

  • Flaky: ComponentsMetricsTest.FailParametersSync_RecordsErrorMetric (timing-sensitive duration assertion) #67305
  • Investigate CSRF usage in Blazor #67081
